stage: Offline certificate classification only; no closed-loop changes
split_rule: paired_initial_key % 3 == 1 -> calibration, otherwise evaluation; same-initial ideal/imperfect pairs stay together
historical_exposure: All cases previously inspected in failure forensics. Evaluation is untouched for THIS calibration, not a never-seen independent holdout.
sample_rule: Every unique issued C1 certificate including initialization; no outcome-based sampling; one episode belongs to one split

velocity_residual.definition: e=max over last 5 unique-source residuals ||v_reported - delta(position)/delta(source_time)||; rho(h)=scale*e*(age+h); cold start abstains for scale>0

acceleration_tube.definition: a=max last 5 ||delta(v_reported)||/delta(source_time); rho(h)=scale*a*(age+h)^2/2. Any positive unbounded acceleration tube invalidates infinite stationary safe-rest; cold start abstains

age_inflation.definition: rho=scale*||v_reported||*age; constant spatial inflation, not a future acceleration bound

track_quality.definition: abstain for duration after observed ID-set change or reported-velocity jump >.3m/s; cold start abstains; 0 disables. No combination with residual tube

calibration_selection.objective: maximize pooled unsafe rejection under constraints; ties choose smaller parameter; method ties use listed order. Select each method parameter and unique overall method on calibration only.

modify_rule: meaningful screening (unsafe rejection>=.5 and safe retention>=.9) but an explicit coverage/timing gap; otherwise Stop. Passing retrospective classification never authorizes automatic prototype.
infinite_rest: Keep original stationary rest extending to infinity. Linear velocity-tube ray checked analytically; positive quadratic tube cannot certify infinite rest.
timing: first rejection of an actually unsafe saved certificate (not a preceding false positive); compare to physical failure and last logged truth-safe/executable evidence. True global last escape remains Unknown.
causality: Features receive only delivered source states, source/receive times, track IDs, and prefix history. No case category, scenario event list, truth indices, future state, or outcome supplied.
